vehicleCycleUseModel.title: Vehicle cycler: cycle this model
vehicleCycleUseModel.desc: Cycle every config of the model of the vehicle you're in

vehicleCycleSetSpot.title: Vehicle cycler: set spawn spot
vehicleCycleSetSpot.desc: Spawn spot = 10 m ahead of the vehicle you're in

vehicleCycleLog.title: Vehicle cycler: log current config to file
vehicleCycleLog.desc: Append the spawned config to vehicleCycle_flagged.txt

vehicleCycleToggleSource.title: Vehicle cycler: switch flagged list / all configs

vehicleCycleScan.title: Vehicle cycler: scan seats
vehicleCycleScan.desc: Spawn every config in the active list and write seat problems to vehicleCycle_seats.txt
